faq.question: Is my JSON data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All processing happens in your browser. Your data never leaves your device. We never see, store, or transmit your JSON data.

faq.question: What indentation options are available?

faq.question: Can I format large JSON files?
faq.answer: Yes. Since all processing happens locally in your browser, you can format JSON files as large as your browser's memory allows. There is no file size limit on our side.

faq.question: Does the formatter also validate JSON?
faq.answer: Yes. If your JSON has syntax errors, the formatter will show the exact error message with line and column numbers so you can quickly fix it.

faq.question: What is the difference between JSON formatter and JSON minifier?
faq.answer: A JSON formatter adds indentation and line breaks to make JSON readable and pretty. A JSON minifier removes all whitespace to make JSON as compact as possible. This online JSON formatter supports both — use Format to beautify your data for readability and Minify for production.

faq.question: Can I share formatted JSON with others?

faq.question: What is the JSON tree view?

article.title: How to Format and Validate JSON Online
article.content:
What is JSON Formatting?

JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) formatting is the process of adding proper indentation and line breaks to make JSON data readable and human-friendly. When JSON is minified or compressed, it appears as a single long line that's difficult to read. Our online JSON formatter transforms this into a structured, pretty print format that's easy to understand and debug.

Why Format JSON Online?

Formatted JSON is essential for developers working with APIs, configuration files, and data storage. Here are common scenarios where JSON formatting helps:

  • API Development: Debug API responses by formatting minified JSON from servers
  • Configuration Files: Read and edit JSON config files like package.json or tsconfig.json
  • Data Analysis: Explore nested JSON structures from databases or analytics
  • Logging: Format JSON logs for better readability during debugging

Common JSON Errors and How to Fix Them

Our JSON formatter includes auto-fix capabilities for these common issues — think of it as a built-in JSON lint and repair tool:

  • Missing Quotes: Keys and string values must be wrapped in double quotes
  • Trailing Commas: Remove commas after the last item in objects or arrays
  • Unclosed Brackets: Automatically close missing curly braces or square brackets
  • Invalid Comments: Remove // and /* */ comments that aren't valid in JSON

Tips for Working with JSON

Here are some best practices for working with JSON data:

  1. Always Validate: Use the validator to check syntax before processing
  2. Use Tree View: Navigate complex nested structures with the expandable tree view
  3. Share Securely: Generate shareable links for collaborative debugging
  4. Minify for Production: Use minified JSON in production to reduce payload size

article.title: 如何在线格式化和验证 JSON
article.content:
什么是 JSON 格式化？

JSON（JavaScript Object Notation）格式化是为 JSON 数据添加适当的缩进和换行，使其更易读、更人性化的过程。当 JSON 被压缩或格式化为一行时，很难阅读和调试。格式化可以将其转换为结构化的缩进格式，便于理解和使用。

为什么要格式化 JSON？

格式化的 JSON 对于处理 API、配置文件和数据存储的开发者来说非常重要。以下是一些常见场景：

  • API 开发：通过格式化服务器返回的压缩 JSON 来调试 API 响应
  • 配置文件：读取和编辑 JSON 配置文件，如 package.json 或 tsconfig.json
  • 数据分析：探索来自数据库或分析工具的嵌套 JSON 结构
  • 日志记录：格式化 JSON 日志以便在调试时更易读

常见 JSON 错误及修复方法

我们的 JSON 格式化工具包含以下常见问题的自动修复功能：

  • 缺失引号：键名和字符串值必须用双引号包裹
  • 尾随逗号：移除对象或数组最后一个元素后的逗号
  • 未闭合括号：自动关闭缺失的花括号或方括号
  • 无效注释：移除 JSON 中不允许的 // 和 /* */ 注释

处理 JSON 的技巧

以下是一些处理 JSON 数据的最佳实践：

  1. 始终验证：在处理前使用验证器检查语法
  2. 使用树形视图：使用可展开的树形视图导航复杂的嵌套结构
  3. 安全分享：生成可分享的链接进行协作调试
  4. 生产环境压缩：在生产环境中使用压缩的 JSON 以减少负载大小
